single_byte_claim.not_generic: not a guarantee for arbitrary buffers, failed user copy, or arbitrary values
single_byte_claim.target_actual: target record is length4 16/19; if user copy succeeds it overwrites 4 bytes and is invalid; if access check fails, buffer remains 1 and this assertion may not fire.
